text:
alex: Heads-up — seeing 502/host mismatch errors from a customer using our private endpoint behind an HTTP proxy. They set a custom base URL, but the Host header ends up as the proxy's internal host. anyone run into this?

sam: yup, classic proxy-host precedence. if the client sends absolute-form requests (proxy style) some proxies rewrite Host. important: TLS+CONNECT preserves SNI but non-CONNECT can change host header.

maria: is the SDK defaulting to absolute-form when HTTP_PROXY is set? node's http library will send absolute URLs to forward proxies unless using a tunnel.

alex: they're on node and using REDWOOD_BASE_URL=https://private.redwood.internal:8443 and HTTP_PROXY=http://proxy.corp:3128. apparently requests are routed through proxy and the proxy rewrites Host to proxy.corp.

sam: quick debugging tips: 1) try forcing CONNECT/tunnel so TLS is end-to-end (no Host rewrite), 2) set a Host header explicitly, or 3) add the private host to NO_PROXY so the proxy is bypassed.

maria: example curl test they can run: 
```
# bypass proxy for the private host
NO_PROXY=private.redwood.internal curl -v https://private.redwood.internal:8443/v1/health
\n# or force Host header if you can't change proxy rules
curl -v -x http://proxy.corp:3128 -H "Host: private.redwood.internal:8443" https://private.redwood.internal:8443/v1/health
```

jen: from SDK side we should document precedence and add an explicit option to prefer baseUrl Host over proxy host. adding something like `forceHostHeader: true` feels hacky but pragmatic. also we should ensure our streaming client uses CONNECT for proxies by default when TLS target != proxy host.

alex: streaming comment matters — their streaming hangs sometimes. might be because proxy closes chunked response or doesn't support http/1.1 chunked upgrades.

sam: yep — some corp proxies don't like long-lived chunked streams. options: 1) use websocket upgrade if proxy allows, 2) use shorter heartbeats and reconnect policy, 3) recommend Dedicated/private peering to avoid corp proxy.

maria: quick SDK patch suggestion for node: when HTTP(S)_PROXY is set and baseUrl starts with https://, prefer using `tunnel`/CONNECT. pseudocode: 
```
const agent = proxy ? tunnel.httpsOverHttp({ proxy: { host, port } }) : https.Agent()
fetch(baseUrl, { agent, headers: { Host: new URL(baseUrl).host } })
```

jen: action items: I'll open a tiny RFC + doc PR: 1) doc section on proxy vs baseUrl Host precedence + recommended env (NO_PROXY example), 2) add a config flag `preserveHost` default true to prefer baseUrl host when possible, 3) make node runtime pick CONNECT for TLS streams.

alex: please also add a troubleshooting checklist for customers who hit 502/host-mismatch. include curl examples and mention SNI vs Host header differences.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: docs/devex/proxy-host-precedence.md -> staging at 2026-03-18 14:00 UTC (:rocket:)

sam: one more gotcha — mTLS setups: if a proxy terminates TLS and re-initiates to upstream, client certs may not be forwarded. doc should say: for mTLS customers, prefer direct route (NO_PROXY) or proxy that supports TLS passthrough.

alex: perfect. jen, can you assign me to the troubleshooting checklist? i'll add the customer's specific curl traces (sanitized).

jen: assigned to alex. I'll open PR with the draft later today. :thumbsup:
